author: Karl Rock
description:
While exploring a thieves market in Karachi, Pakistan, I came across a seller offering some rather unusual products. Among his items were traditional herbal pain oil and what looked like natural musk, a substance associated with musk deer and used in perfumes and traditional remedies.

Natural musk from musk deer is heavily protected under international wildlife trade regulations, and its sale can be illegal without the appropriate permits. I also question whether the herbal pain oil actually works, as there is no reliable scientific evidence that these kinds of traditional remedies provide the claimed pain relief.

You never know what you'll find when exploring Pakistan's markets!
title: I Found Something Illegal in Pakistan
